filters.name: Subdivision Surfaces: Loop
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Apply Loop's Subdivision Surface algorithm. It is an approximant refinement method and it works for every triangle and has rules for extraordinary vertices.

parameters.label: Weighting Scheme
parameters.help: Change the weights used. Allows one to optimize some behaviors over others.

parameters.label: Iterations
parameters.help: Number of times the model is subdivided.

parameters.label: Edge Threshold
parameters.help: All edges longer than this threshold are refined. Zero means uniform refinement.

parameters.label: Affect only selected faces
parameters.help: If selected the filter affects only selected faces.

filters.name: Subdivision Surfaces: Butterfly Subdivision
